_comment: Names this crate implements that the reference does not register.
Each entry needs a reason: an undocumented addition is indistinguishable from
a mistake, and a helper that exists only in one implementation would make a
template written against the reference fail elsewhere.
The single entry is not a template helper: it is the name a Value::Method
carries so an engine can dispatch `{{ (semver "1.3.3").Compare }}` through
its function map. The reference implements the same method; it simply never
has to name it, because its engine holds the delegate.

additions.name: semver.Compare
additions.reason: The method a semver object carries. Reached through Value::Method, never written as a helper name in a template, and it must be registered by name for that form to render.
